_about: Every line Settings and the update banner showed under the update buttons before #97, as app.js said it for each answer the monitor gives (webui_checks.js's updateSaid, run on the code before the move), in capitals; what the Gates theme showed of it (gates.js re-cased it); and the catalog key that holds it since #97, with its values. The catalog's English is the Gates text, and Nostromo and Night City set it in capitals by CSS: today's line. Made once from the code before #97 (step b1), never re-recorded.
